caption:
You still fight the same old pull, and it wrecks you. You call the struggle proof that you're failing — but what if it's proof that you're finally alive? (Galatians 5:24 devotional)

You read the wrestling as failure — every "I shouldn't be doing this" feels like defeat. But a corpse feels no pull; the very conflict means the Spirit has planted a new standard in you, so the fight is a pulse, not a verdict. Those who belong to Him have already crucified the flesh, and the victory you're straining toward was settled at the cross — which turns "wretched man that I am" into "thanks be to God."
